text:
{faith:nature}管回归与容纳，和生命密切相关，信徒极广。奉祂时，一场里实际回的生命够数、放出过生息，经验值各再多给。献祭爱自然之物、食物与防具。自然之神赐福盾牌、防具和自然道具，赐福版激活即加生命，再按经验值累计：盾牌加格挡，别的加护甲上限。

奉了祂，战斗里每隔 {faith_perk:nature:nature_regrowth:pulse_sec} 秒恢复一点生命；实际回上来的生命有一部分存进【生息】，有上限，满血时的治疗存不进去。一阶起生命值低于 {faith_perk:nature:nature_regrowth:low_percent}% 时放出生息补血；二阶棋盘上的食物让生息存得更多，二阶还能在神坛上献祭食物时顺带恢复体力；三阶进入加时时得到一阵【守护】，受到的伤害降低。

texts.en:
{faith:nature} governs return and containment, is closely bound to life, and has followers almost everywhere. While you follow this god, you gain extra XP for healing enough in a battle and for releasing Regrowth. Offerings favor natural things, food and armor. The God of Nature blesses shields, armor and natural items: a Blessed version adds Health on activation, then builds with your XP, adding Block to shields and max Armor to everything else.

Following this god, you restore a little Health every {faith_perk:nature:nature_regrowth:pulse_sec} seconds in battle, and part of the Health actually restored is stored as Regrowth, up to a cap; healing at full Health stores nothing. From Rank one, while your Health is below {faith_perk:nature:nature_regrowth:low_percent}%, Regrowth is released as healing. At Rank two, food on the board raises Regrowth capacity, and offering food at an Altar also restores Vitality. At Rank three, you gain Guard when Overtime starts, taking less damage for a moment.
